critic.fix_suggestion: Parent the engine geometries to the wing pylon primitives. Apply a local translation of [0, 0, 0] relative to the pylon's mounting face and set the rotation to match the pylon's orientation (typically -5 degrees pitch). Ensure the engine's bounding box intersects with the pylon geometry by at least 15% of its width to eliminate visual gaps.

discrepancies.observed: Engines are floating independently near the wing and fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are physically attached to pylons under the wings.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Attach/parent engines to wing pylon geometries.

discrepancies.observed: Landing gear struts are detached from the main fuselage and wing roots.
discrepancies.reference: Struts connect directly to the underside of the fuselage and wing structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach landing gear bases to fuselage/wing bottom surfaces.

discrepancies.observed: The wings appear to be floating away from the main body.
discrepancies.reference: Wings are integrated into the lower side of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move wing roots inward and downward to meet the fuselage surface.

discrepancies.observed: The vertical stabilizer is detached from the rear fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The tail is structurally joined to the top-rear of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach vertical stabilizer to the rear fuselage top.
